name: wikipedia-test
build: xcodebuild build-for-testing -project Wikipedia.xcodeproj -scheme Wikipedia -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath "$DERIVED_DATA" -resultBundlePath "$RESULT_BUNDLE" -skipMacroValidation -skipPackagePluginValidation ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES SWIFT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=-Onone SWIFT_COMPILATION_MODE=singlefile GCC_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=0 COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO
test: xcodebuild test-without-building -project Wikipedia.xcodeproj -scheme Wikipedia -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -destination "$TEST_DESTINATION" -derivedDataPath "$DERIVED_DATA" -resultBundlePath "$RESULT_BUNDLE" ${WARMBUILD_ONLY_TESTING:-} ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES SWIFT_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=-Onone SWIFT_COMPILATION_MODE=singlefile GCC_OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL=0 COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO
